title: Trust Account Interest Counted as Income in a Coming Pending Month's Estimate
content:
Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, interest credited to the resident's funds account under Resident Trust Fund Accounts is counted as income in the estimate behind an advance toward a coming pending month. The resident's funds account is the resident's account in status active.

**Rule.** The interest counted as income in a coming pending month's estimate: where interest was credited to the resident's funds account within the last month, the latest interest credit; where interest was credited within the last three months but not within the last month, one third of the interest credited in those three months, rounded half up to the cent; otherwise none. The interest counted is added to income before the estimate's floor at zero.

**Questions and answers.**

*Interest was credited within the last month.* The latest interest credit is counted. Where two credits share the latest date, the one posted first is the latest.

*The most recent credit was five weeks ago, and two credits fell within the last three months — 3.12 and 2.95 dollars.* One third of 6.07 dollars, 2.0233 dollars, rounded half up to the cent: 2.02 dollars.

*The most recent interest credit is more than three months old.* No interest is counted.
